description:
At Apple, great ideas have a way of becoming great products, services, and customer experiences very quickly. Bring passion and dedication to your job and there's no telling what you could accomplish.

Are you interested in building the next generation of iOS apps? The Journal team at Apple is looking for talented iOS App developers to join a small team of highly skilled engineers to build world class applications across all of Apple’s platforms. As a member of our team, you'll be responsible for building features for upcoming releases, prototyping new feature concepts, and making sure our users always have a great experience.

Description
This position requires deep knowledge of Swift and UIKit/SwiftUI. You must be comfortable with rapidly evolving designs and requirements, and have excellent interpersonal skills. Throughout the process, you will work collaboratively with our world-class team of engineers, partner with designers, and coordinate with other teams at Apple including the iOS and macOS teams.

Responsibilities
Implementing new features 
Prototyping new ideas to help with initial feature definition 
Communicating ideas to the Apple design team and other cross functional teams 
Participating in architecture and code reviews 
Exploring new frameworks and technologies and how they can aid in implementing new features 
Building internal tools as needed to help ship high quality software

Minimum qualifications
2+ years of experience with Swift and/or Objective-C design patterns
2+ years of experience with UIKit and/or SwiftUI
Talent for cleanly architecting UI features
Experience with AI assisted development tools
Excellent oral and written communication skills
BS in Computer Science or equivalent

Preferred qualifications
Passion for quality and attention to detail
Aptitude to independently learn new technologies
Enthusiasm for delivering exceptional product experiences
